spells.name: Summon Darkfire Daemonrift
spells.effect: Set up a **^^Darkfire Daemonrift^^** wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
spells.declare: If there is not a friendly **Darkfire Daemonrift** on the battlefield, pick a friendly **^^Slaves to Darkness Wizard^^** to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
